beforeImage.description: Donjon Marine Co., LLC provides marine salvage, dredging, towing, heavy lift, remediation, and related marine infrastructure services. Its customers or end markets include ports, infrastructure owners, insurers, industrial operators, and public-sector marine customers. The operating model is an asset-heavy marine services model supported by vessels, shipyard capacity, and specialized operating equipment. Operations are concentrated in New Jersey with project activity across U.S. waterways and coastal markets. Public materials indicate a business history dating to 1964 and a fleet and service offering spanning salvage, dredging, and marine contracting. Current ownership dates to Tallvine Partners’ 2025 acquisition and launch of a North America marine infrastructure platform around Donjon.

afterImage.name: Tallvine North America Marine Infrastructure Platform
afterImage.subsector: Marine salvage, dredging, towing, heavy lift, and marine infrastructure services
afterImage.description: Tallvine North America Marine Infrastructure Platform is the manager-level proxy for two separately branded U.S. marine-services operators: Donjon Marine and Lind Marine. Donjon provides salvage, dredging, towing, heavy lift, remediation, construction and related services through a fleet, shipyard, drydock, berth and processing assets serving ports, infrastructure owners, insurers, industrial operators and public-sector customers. Lind adds a West Coast fleet and shipyard footprint serving industrial, utility, municipal, government and waterfront customers. Tallvine acquired Donjon in September 2025 as the platform cornerstone and added Lind in May 2026. Tallvine is the lead sponsor and Thoroughbred is the continuing industrial partner and a disclosed co-buyer of Donjon; the exact fund, investment vehicle, ownership percentages, governance and legal umbrella are not publicly disclosed. Donjon and Lind remain separate operating brands, so their subsidiaries, vessels, yards and other assets stay beneath this single manager-level record.
